csv_path <- "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv"

# Load required packages
suppressPackageStartupMessages({

# Inspect the XLSX differential analysis file
xlsx_path <- "inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx"
sheets <- excel_sheets(xlsx_path)

# Load data
csv_path <- "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv"
# Read the CSV with proper handling
raw <- read.csv(csv_path, skip = 1, check.names = FALSE)
cat("Original column names:\n")
print(colnames(raw))
# Set the column names from second row
samples <- read.csv(csv_path, skip = 1, nrows = 1, header = FALSE)
real_colnames <- as.character(samples[1, ])
cat("\nSample names:\n")
print(real_colnames)
# Reload with correct names
header <- readLines(csv_path, n = 2)
cn <- strsplit(header[2], ",")[[1]]
df <- read.csv(csv_path, skip = 2, header = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
colnames(df) <- cn
cat("\nFinal column names:\n")
print(colnames(df))
cat(sprintf("\nRows: %d\n", nrow(df)))
cat("\nFirst few rows:\n")
print(head(df, 3))

# Deduplicate gene IDs - keep first occurrence
dup_check <- data.frame(id = df$id, is_dup = duplicated(df$id))
cat(sprintf("Total rows: %d\n", nrow(df)))
cat(sprintf("Unique gene IDs: %d\n", length(unique(df$id))))
cat(sprintf("Duplicate rows: %d\n", sum(duplicated(df$id))))
# Check unique IDs
df_unique <- df[!duplicated(df$id), ]
rownames(df_unique) <- df_unique$id
df_unique$id <- NULL
cat(sprintf("\nAfter dedup: %d genes\n", nrow(df_unique)))
# Check for NA values
cat(sprintf("NA values: %d\n", sum(is.na(df_unique))))
# Look at value distribution
cat("\nValue range:\n")
print(range(as.matrix(df_unique), na.rm = TRUE))
cat("\nSample column means:\n")
print(round(colMeans(df_unique), 3))

# Split samples into 4 groups based on naming convention
cohort_a_ctrl_samples <- c("CohortActrl1", "CohortActrl2", "CohortActrl4")
cohort_a_si_samples   <- c("CohortAsi1", "CohortAsi2", "CohortAsi5")
cohort_b_ctrl_samples <- c("CohortBctrl1", "CohortBctrl2", "CohortBctrl4")
cohort_b_si_samples   <- c("CohortBsi1", "CohortBsi2", "CohortBsi3")
# Verify samples exist
cat("CohortA ctrl:", cohort_a_ctrl_samples %in% colnames(df_unique), "\n")
cat("CohortA si:", cohort_a_si_samples %in% colnames(df_unique), "\n")
cat("CohortB ctrl:", cohort_b_ctrl_samples %in% colnames(df_unique), "\n")
cat("CohortB si:", cohort_b_si_samples %in% colnames(df_unique), "\n")
# Differential analysis: Compute log2FC and p-values for two comparisons
# Since data is already log2-transformed, mean difference = log2FC directly
compute_diff <- function(expr_mat, ctrl_samples, trt_samples) {
  ctrl_mat <- expr_mat[, ctrl_samples]
  trt_mat  <- expr_mat[, trt_samples]
  ctrl_mean <- rowMeans(ctrl_mat)
  trt_mean  <- rowMeans(trt_mat)
  log2fc    <- trt_mean - ctrl_mean
  
  # Welch t-test per gene
  pvals <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(expr_mat)), function(i) {
    tryCatch({
      ttest <- t.test(trt_mat[i, ], ctrl_mat[i, ], var.equal = FALSE)
      ttest$p.value
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  })
  
  data.frame(
    id = rownames(expr_mat),
    log2FoldChange = log2fc,
    pvalue = pvals,
    baseMean = (ctrl_mean + trt_mean) / 2,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
# Comparison 1: CohortA_si vs CohortA_ctrl
res_cohort_a <- compute_diff(df_unique, cohort_a_ctrl_samples, cohort_a_si_samples)
colnames(res_cohort_a)[2:4] <- paste0("CohortA_", colnames(res_cohort_a)[2:4])
# Comparison 2: CohortB_si vs CohortB_ctrl
res_cohort_b <- compute_diff(df_unique, cohort_b_ctrl_samples, cohort_b_si_samples)
colnames(res_cohort_b)[2:4] <- paste0("CohortB_", colnames(res_cohort_b)[2:4])
# Merge
diff_df <- merge(res_cohort_a, res_cohort_b, by = "id")
cat(sprintf("\nMerged results: %d genes\n", nrow(diff_df)))
cat("\nSummary of CohortA log2FC:\n")
print(summary(diff_df$CohortA_log2FoldChange))
cat("\nSummary of CohortB log2FC:\n")
print(summary(diff_df$CohortB_log2FoldChange))
cat("\nFirst 5 results:\n")
print(head(diff_df[, c("id", "CohortA_log2FoldChange", "CohortA_pvalue", "CohortB_log2FoldChange", "CohortB_pvalue")], 5))

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
})
# Significance thresholds
p_cut <- 0.05
fc_cut <- log2(1.5)  # |log2FC| > 0.585
# Classify genes
classify_gene <- function(cohort_a_fc, cohort_a_p, cohort_b_fc, cohort_b_p, p_cut, fc_cut) {
  cohort_a_sig <- !is.na(cohort_a_p) & cohort_a_p < p_cut & abs(cohort_a_fc) > fc_cut
  cohort_b_sig <- !is.na(cohort_b_p) & cohort_b_p < p_cut & abs(cohort_b_fc) > fc_cut
  
  case_when(
    cohort_a_sig & cohort_b_sig & (cohort_a_fc * cohort_b_fc > 0) ~ "Both (same direction)",
    cohort_a_sig & cohort_b_sig & (cohort_a_fc * cohort_b_fc < 0) ~ "Both (opposite direction)",
    cohort_a_sig & !cohort_b_sig                          ~ "CohortA only",
    !cohort_a_sig & cohort_b_sig                          ~ "CohortB only",
    TRUE                                       ~ "NS"
  )
}
diff_df$status <- classify_gene(
  diff_df$CohortA_log2FoldChange, diff_df$CohortA_pvalue,
  diff_df$CohortB_log2FoldChange, diff_df$CohortB_pvalue,
  p_cut, fc_cut
)
# Order factor levels so NS is plotted first (background), then the highlighted groups
diff_df$status <- factor(diff_df$status, levels = c(
  "NS", "CohortA only", "CohortB only", "Both (opposite direction)", "Both (same direction)"
))
cat("Category counts:\n")
print(table(diff_df$status))
# Top genes for labeling (most significant in each group)
top_labels <- rbind(
  head(diff_df[diff_df$status == "Both (same direction)", ][order(diff_df$CohortA_pvalue[diff_df$status == "Both (same direction)"]), ], 5),
  head(diff_df[diff_df$status == "Both (opposite direction)", ][order(diff_df$CohortA_pvalue[diff_df$status == "Both (opposite direction)"]), ], 5),
  head(diff_df[diff_df$status == "CohortA only", ][order(diff_df$CohortA_pvalue[diff_df$status == "CohortA only"]), ], 5),
  head(diff_df[diff_df$status == "CohortB only", ][order(diff_df$CohortB_pvalue[diff_df$status == "CohortB only"]), ], 5)
)
top_labels <- unique(top_labels)
cat(sprintf("\nGenes to label: %d\n", nrow(top_labels)))

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(dplyr)
})
# Significance thresholds
p_cut <- 0.05
fc_cut <- log2(1.5)  # |log2FC| > 0.585
# Classify genes (using base R since case_when may not be available)
cohort_a_sig <- !is.na(diff_df$CohortA_pvalue) & diff_df$CohortA_pvalue < p_cut & abs(diff_df$CohortA_log2FoldChange) > fc_cut
cohort_b_sig <- !is.na(diff_df$CohortB_pvalue) & diff_df$CohortB_pvalue < p_cut & abs(diff_df$CohortB_log2FoldChange) > fc_cut
both_same <- cohort_a_sig & cohort_b_sig & (diff_df$CohortA_log2FoldChange * diff_df$CohortB_log2FoldChange > 0)
both_opp  <- cohort_a_sig & cohort_b_sig & (diff_df$CohortA_log2FoldChange * diff_df$CohortB_log2FoldChange < 0)
diff_df$status <- "NS"
diff_df$status[cohort_a_sig & !cohort_b_sig] <- "CohortA only"
diff_df$status[!cohort_a_sig & cohort_b_sig] <- "CohortB only"
diff_df$status[both_opp]           <- "Both (opposite direction)"
diff_df$status[both_same]          <- "Both (same direction)"
diff_df$status <- factor(diff_df$status, levels = c(
  "NS", "CohortA only", "CohortB only", "Both (opposite direction)", "Both (same direction)"
))
cat("Category counts:\n")
print(table(diff_df$status))
# Top genes for labeling
get_top <- function(subset_df, p_col, k = 5) {
  if (nrow(subset_df) == 0) return(subset_df[0, ])
  ord <- order(subset_df[[p_col]])
  head(subset_df[ord, ], min(k, nrow(subset_df)))
}
top_labels <- rbind(
  get_top(diff_df[diff_df$status == "Both (same direction)", ], "CohortA_pvalue"),
  get_top(diff_df[diff_df$status == "Both (opposite direction)", ], "CohortA_pvalue"),
  get_top(diff_df[diff_df$status == "CohortA only", ], "CohortA_pvalue"),
  get_top(diff_df[diff_df$status == "CohortB only", ], "CohortB_pvalue")
)
top_labels <- unique(top_labels)
cat(sprintf("\nGenes to label: %d\n", nrow(top_labels)))

# Build the diagonal volcano plot
max_abs_fc <- max(abs(c(diff_df$CohortA_log2FoldChange, diff_df$CohortB_log2FoldChange)), na.rm = TRUE)
lim <- ceiling(max_abs_fc * 10) / 10
status_colors <- c(
  "NS"                          = "grey75",
  "CohortA only"                    = "#1f77b4",
  "CohortB only"                    = "#ff7f0e",
  "Both (opposite direction)"   = "#2ca02c",
  "Both (same direction)"       = "#d62728"
)
p <- ggplot(diff_df, aes(x = CohortA_log2FoldChange, y = CohortB_log2FoldChange)) +
  # Background non-significant points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(diff_df, status == "NS"),
    aes(color = status), size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # Highlighted significant groups
  geom_point(
    data = subset(diff_df, status != "NS"),
    aes(color = status), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  # Reference diagonal line (y = x) and threshold cross
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-fc_cut, fc_cut), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cut, fc_cut), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_labels,
    aes(label = id),
    size = 3, max.overlaps = 30, segment.color = "grey40", segment.size = 0.2,
    box.padding = 0.3, point.padding = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = status_colors, drop = FALSE, name = NULL) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim), clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Diagonal Volcano Plot: CohortA si vs ctrl  |  CohortB si vs ctrl",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "p < %.2f, |log2FC| > log2(1.5) = %.2f; %d genes",
      p_cut, fc_cut, nrow(diff_df)
    ),
    x = "log2FC (CohortA si vs CohortA ctrl)",
    y = "log2FC (CohortB si vs CohortB ctrl)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "center"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)))
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", plot = p, width = 9, height = 9, dpi = 200)
cat("Saved diagonal_volcano.png\n")
cat(sprintf("File size: %.1f KB\n", file.info("diagonal_volcano.png")$size / 1024))
# Also save the differential analysis table
write.csv(diff_df, "diagonal_volcano_diff.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved diagonal_volcano_diff.csv\n")
cat(sprintf("File size: %.1f KB\n", file.info("diagonal_volcano_diff.csv")$size / 1024))
